assertions.name: R_is_a_rational_function_of_q0_over_Q
assertions.detail: u enters only as u^2 = b^2*hbar^4 and b^2 = (h^2+3)/(h^2+4) is rational in q, so the square root cancels identically. The closed form -2*Q_beta*q^7*(q^2+1)^2 / [m_e*(q+1)*(q^2-2q-1)*(4q^7-5q^6+8q^5-7q^4+8q^3-7q^2+4q-1)] reproduces the acos input to 60 digits. Degree 11 over 10, coefficients rational (m_e and Q_beta are CODATA decimals).

assertions.name: niven_excludes_every_N_if_q0_is_rational
assertions.detail: R is 0.00160233 from the nearest Niven value (1), so if q_0 were rational -- making R rational by step 1 -- no rational multiple of 2pi could have cosine R, for any k or N. Mathlib: Mathlib.NumberTheory.Niven.niven.

assertions.name: transcendental_q0_excludes_every_N
assertions.detail: 2cos(r*pi) is an algebraic integer for every rational r (Mathlib: isIntegral_two_mul_cos_rat_mul_pi). By step 1, R = P(q_0)/Q(q_0) with P, Q in Q[x] and non-constant; if R were algebraic then q_0 would be a root of the nonzero polynomial P(x) - R*Q(x) over the algebraic numbers, hence algebraic. Contrapositive: q_0 transcendental => R transcendental => 2R is not an algebraic integer => R != cos(2*pi*k/N) for any k, N.

assertions.name: vol41_is_a_rational_function_of_q0
assertions.detail: m_p/m_e = 2*(Vol/hbar_q^2)*F_Bor(q) - 12 has every factor rational in q (h = q-1/q, hbar_q = 1-1/q, trM = |(4+h^2-3h^4-h^6)/(h^2+4)|, qf3 = (q^2+1+q^-2)(q+1/q)), so Vol = (m_p/m_e + 12)*hbar_q^2/(2*F_Bor) is a rational function of q_0 with rational coefficients. Reproduced to 1.87e-60. Hence q_0 algebraic => Vol(4_1) algebraic, and contrapositively Vol(4_1) transcendental => q_0 transcendental.

assertions.name: surviving_branch_carries_an_exact_degree_requirement
assertions.detail: if theta = 2*pi*k/N with gcd(k,N) = 1 then 2cos(theta) generates the maximal real subfield Q(zeta_N)^+ and has degree exactly phi(N)/2 over Q. So the one open branch is not 'find N' but 'is 2R an algebraic integer, and of what degree' -- a question about R's minimal polynomial, which is decidable in principle, unlike the rationality of theta/2pi read off digits.

assertions.name: no_search_on_the_target_was_run
assertions.detail: The derivation in steps 1-4 never consults which N is numerically near theta/2pi. N = 111 is not used, tested or scored anywhere in this probe; the degree table in step 5 reports the candidates #6755 had already recorded and selects among none of them. Invariant first, target never searched (AGENTS.md formalize-first).

description: The route-5 N question on |q| = 1 is not undecidable: R = cos(theta) is a rational function of q_0 over Q (the square root in u cancels), so Niven closes the rational branch and the algebraic integrality of 2cos(r*pi) closes the transcendental branch. The surviving branch requires Vol(4_1) = 2Cl_2(pi/3) to be algebraic, so the N question IS the transcendence of the figure-eight hyperbolic volume. Scope-(b) conditional; no search on the target. Exact mpmath at 60 dps and exact integers; no float64.
